title: My Faceless Classmate, Wakao
titleRomaji: Tonari no Wakao-san wa Miesou de Mienai
titleNative: 隣の若尾さんは見えそうで見えない
synonyms: My Seatmate Wakao-san's Face Is Almost Visible but It's Not
synopsis: Mizuno, your average high-school guy, finds himself sitting next to the mysterious Wakao after a seat change. While everyone else in class sees her as a perfectly beautiful, ordinary girl... To Mizuno alone, she appears as a Noppera-bo, the faceless yokai of Japanese folklore! Yet... every so often, he’s actually able to catch rare, fleeting glimpses of her features. In this romantic, often comedic coming-of-age tale, we follow this endearing couple as they navigate through the tribulations of high-school and first love! (Source: Manga UP!)

title: Charisma: Charisma na Karera wa Charisma House de Karizumai Chuu
titleRomaji: Charisma: Charisma na Karera wa Charisma House de Karizumai Chuu
titleNative: カリスマ 〜カリスマな彼らはカリスマハウスで仮住まい中〜
synopsis: The popular two-dimensional character content "Charisma" is developed as a story manga! This is Charisma House, where charismatic people live. Charismatic people are looking at the charisma inside of them every day. Charismatics huddle together, nurturing their charisma day by day and aiming for a higher level of charisma, so to speak, in a state of temporary residence. Will they ever reach "true charisma"...? ...This is a story of charismatics, though ordinary people may not understand it well. (Source: Kodansha, translated)

synopsis: Cleo is a mercenary whose dream is to buy his own home and live peacefully. But while he’s fleeing from a group of bandits that were unexpectedly strong, he meets a mysterious demi-human girl named Kohaku that claims to have foreseen his death. title: Nihao, Oishii Tokyo Biyori.
titleNative: ニーハオ、おいしい東京日和。
synonyms: Ni Hao, Delicious Days in Tokyo.
synopsis: The joy and loneliness of living by yourself in Tokyo. If you go around to the back of the building, look for a sign with unreadable characters, there you will find a person surrounded by a cloud of exotic fragrance. This is another side of Tokyo - a city full of unfamiliar flavors. Foreigners in Tokyo live hopeful but anxious lives. This new series vividly captures their "food landscape." An immigrant's gourmet experience, living life at his own pace. (Source: to-t.in, translated)

titleNative: 寡黙だけどめちゃくちゃノリのいい黒猫ちゃん
synonyms: Taciturn But Absurdly Enthusiastic Black Cat–chan
The Quiet but Incredibly Spirited Black Cat Girl
A quiet but extremely cheerful black cat
synopsis: I thought Kuroi-san, the classmate sitting next to me, was quiet, but she turns out to be a cheerful girl with a cat-like charm!? Akama-kun, the protagonist aiming for a fresh start in high school, keeps trying to become popular but always ends up fumbling instead. Kuroi-san, the cat-like girl who’s been giving him cold stares, is actually incredibly lively — and by wholeheartedly going along with his clumsy invitations, she helps to brighten up the lives of Akama-kun and their classmates. A cat-themed romantic comedy with a surprising twist that took social media by storm! (Source: Square Enix, translated) Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, it was then licensed by Square Enix for serialization on 2025-12-27.

title: Ebichu Minds the House
titleNative: おるちゅばんエビちゅ
synopsis: Episodes follow Ebichu, a talking hamster devoted to her oft-indifferent owner, who is only identified as OL ("Office Lady"), a single 25-year-old (this is the age Japanese women are considered nearing the end of the ideal marrying age) who doles out cynical commentary and the occasional beating on the rodent. Ebichu tends to take this in stride with endless praise and compliments. Such abuse is usually caused by Ebichu's almost disturbing lack of tact or propriety, often embarrassing her master in front of other people. Ebichu often attempts to correct OL's bad decisions, such as her berating of OL's obnoxious and untrustworthy boyfriend Ebichu nicknamed Kaishounachi (literally, Useless).

title: Eko Eko Azaraku
synopsis: When the chant "Eko Eko Azarak" sounds something is bound to occur, be it within the town or the school! A classic horror manga, Eko Eko Azarak follows the witch Misa Kuroi ("Black Mass" in Japanese), and the various horrors she encounters during her travels. While relatively unknown outside of Japan the series was extremely well received domestically. It lasted for 19 volumes, spawned two sequels, an OVA, two TV series, six live action films and two video games. Included one-shot: Volume 19: Hitokui Ichizoku
